title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: liability measure and Hague-Visby limits by tier
content:
## Scope

This quick-reference card belongs to the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line. It states, for each of the six product tiers, how the line's liability for loss of or damage to cargo is measured, together with the Hague-Visby limitation figures and the SDR conversion rate of the line's claims tariff.

## Tier card

| Tier (rank) | Liability measure | Hague-Visby limit per package or unit | Hague-Visby limit per kilogram | Claims tariff conversion rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Standard Carrier Liability (1) | Hague-Visby limitation | 666.67 SDR | 2.00 SDR | 1.3385 USD per SDR |
| AHL Declared Value Liability (2) | Declared value | 666.67 SDR | 2.00 SDR | 1.3385 USD per SDR |
| AHL CargoCare Essential (3) | CargoCare cover | 666.67 SDR | 2.00 SDR | 1.3385 USD per SDR |
| AHL CargoCare Plus (4) | CargoCare cover | 666.67 SDR | 2.00 SDR | 1.3385 USD per SDR |
| AHL CargoCare Premium (5) | CargoCare cover | 666.67 SDR | 2.00 SDR | 1.3385 USD per SDR |
| AHL CargoCare Total (6) | CargoCare cover | 666.67 SDR | 2.00 SDR | 1.3385 USD per SDR |

## What each column means

- **Liability measure** is how the line's liability is measured under the tier: Hague-Visby limitation, declared value, or CargoCare cover.
- **Limit per package or unit** is the Hague-Visby limit for each package or unit enumerated on the transport document, in SDR.
- **Limit per kilogram** is the Hague-Visby limit for each kilogram of gross weight of the goods lost or damaged, in SDR.
- Both Hague-Visby limits are used only where the tier's liability measure is Hague-Visby limitation.
- **Conversion rate** converts SDR into US dollars under the line's claims tariff, stated in USD per SDR to 4 decimal places.

## Points of judgement

**Does the per-package figure in the AHL CargoCare Plus row limit a CargoCare Plus settlement?**
No. The Hague-Visby limits are used only under the Hague-Visby limitation measure, and the card shows that measure only for AHL Standard Carrier Liability; CargoCare Plus is measured as CargoCare cover.

**Which tier is measured by declared value?**
Only AHL Declared Value Liability (rank 2).

**Why do all six rows carry the same limits and rate?**
The tariff figures are held on every tier, but they come into use only on the tier measured by Hague-Visby limitation.
